product_summary: Website (technoworldcorporation.com, Rajkot, Gujarat) lists: refractory & insulating materials (fire bricks, magnesite bricks, magnesia carbon, chrome magnesite, high alumina bricks, fire clay, CF/HFK insulation bricks, kiln fired bricks); cements/mortars/binders (high alumina binders Calundum and GR-AL75, 90K/70K mortar, resin mortar, sulphur mortar, bitumen mastic/primer, low cement castable, refractory cement); foundry consumables (cupola bricks, coconut shell coke, steel shots, thermocouple tips, ceramic blanket/board/module/paper, honeycomb & ceramic foam filters, perlite ore, rockwool, dense castables Whytheat A/K/C, Fire Crete, silica ramming mass, ceramic anchors); kiln flow control refractories (ladle well block, ladle bricks, silica tundish board, tundish nozzle, nozzle filling compound, nozzle blocks, shoulder & hunger bricks, boric acid & bentonite, slide gate refractories, PCPF blocks, brown fused alumina, stoneware pipe, gaskets, boiler bed materials, calcium silicate blocks); plus separate divisions: Engineering, Mechanical, Packaging, Tools & Gauges, Electrical, Safety Equipment, and Sanitary Ware (wash basins, pedestals, wall-hung/table-top basins, water closets, one-piece and close-coupled toilets, squatting pans, urinals, cisterns, washbasin cabinets) and Ceramic Tiles.
role_hint: trader / manufacturer_trader - site claims 'manufacturers, exporters & suppliers' and 'industrial manufacturing company', but the catalogue spans unrelated verticals (refractories, sanitary ware, ceramic tiles, electrical, safety equipment, packaging, tools & gauges), which is a classic multi-line trading/indenting profile rather than a single-plant manufacturer. No factory/plant address or unit details published on the homepage; registered address is an office (A-906, Om Decora 9 Square, Rajkot).
comment: HS 870899 (parts and accessories of motor vehicles, headings 8701-8705) is not corroborated by anything in the published catalogue: no automotive, vehicle-part or transport-equipment line appears anywhere on the site. Industry claim 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is a misclassification - the actual industry is refractory/industrial minerals, ceramic sanitary ware and general industrial trading. Corrected code family is 6902/6903/3816/6815 (refractories and refractory cements) as the core, with 6907/6908 (tiles), 6910 (sanitary ware), 2818 (brown fused alumina) and 7325/7326 (foundry consumables) as secondary lines. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: refractories, castables/mortars, ceramic fibre insulation, sanitary ware, ceramic tiles, foundry consumables, electrical/safety/packaging divisions. All product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked or found in this pass (product/HS scope only; registries, revenue and customs volumes not researched per role). Sub-pages /products returned HTTP 404 and /about-us returned HTTP 403, so catalogue detail beyond the homepage navigation could not be read; search backend was unavailable (connection refused), so no third-party catalogue (IndiaMART etc.) could be cross-checked - null for any external corroboration.
